# thousandeyes_credential (Resource)

Manages a ThousandEyes credential: a named secret whose value is stored encrypted and used by browser synthetics transaction tests. The create and update responses deliberately omit the value; state is populated by the read that follows, which returns it decrypted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Code generated by tfpfgen. DO NOT EDIT.

resource "thousandeyes_credential" "example" {
  name  = "tfacc-name"
  value = "tfacc-value"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the credential.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The value of the credential, stored encrypted. Sensitive: it is a secret, and the matching ephemeral resource exists so other providers can consume it without it ever reaching their state. <!-- probed:7.0.97-t1785500668022 --> The API enforces this field's presence, which the specification does not declare. <!-- /probed -->

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique ID of the credential.
